Equipment makers pivot to outcome businesses: connected machines, service contracts and uptime guarantees replace box sales. The pivot is an engineering program — fleet connectivity, service intelligence and outcome pricing — built once, monetized for decades.

items: Failure data accumulates without models; warranty and design loops closed by anecdote.
Machines in the field lack telemetry; service is reactive and parts planning blind.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Generative AI Platform Engineering, Conversational AI & Digital Humans, Conversational AI & Digital Humans from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Fleet connectivity/OTA, Service dispatch and parts, Outcome/uptime contracts) on Driisti Smart Vision Glasses and Fleet Management System and EEMS Platform. Governance inherits the sector frame — EU Machinery Regulation/CRA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Align AI to P&L lines and risk mandates — a sequenced portfolio, not a pile of pilots.
One governed platform, many GenAI products — retrieval, guardrails and cost control as shared services.
